Skill: Large Language Models

Category:
Generative AI

Description:
Large Language Models are AI models designed to understand and generate human language.

Core Topics:

* Prompt Engineering
* Text Generation
* Context
* Model APIs
* LLM Applications

Used In:

* AI Engineer
* Generative AI Engineer
* NLP Engineer

Recommended Practice:

* Build an application using an LLM API.
* Experiment with prompts.
* Build a question-answering application.
